other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered folk artist
Registered folk artist must have no dues payable to the Board
Assistance can be sought for the artist’s own marriage or for the marriage of their adult son or daughter
If both husband and wife are registered folk artists, only one of them is eligible per marriage
The family of a registered folk artist can avail the assistance only twice
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 for the marriage of a registered folk artist or their adult child.
